input.reasoning_summary: All three challenges were refuted by the evidence. H1: The VIZIO acquisition occurred in fiscal 2025 (prior year), not fiscal 2026, so it does not distort the FY2026 comparison. Revenue growth was driven by organic comparable sales growth. H2: Currency fluctuations actually negatively impacted net sales by $2.8 billion in fiscal 2026, meaning the reported 4.7% growth understates the operational performance rather than overstates it. H3: The evidence confirms that the 4.7% growth rate explicitly applies to 'total revenues' (which includes both net sales and membership/other income), not just net sales. Multiple sources (E1, E17, E18) consistently show total revenues grew 4.7% in fiscal 2026. Since 4.7% > 4%, the claim remains supported.
